about: Abilities: what a creature can choose to do. Orsino skills and spells are generated into data/catalog/orsino/abilities.json; this file holds Kyr's own abilities and adaptations. kind is technique, spell (with tradition, level and school or domain; a spell spends one slot) or natural. effect is written in the Kyr effect language; effects is the typed form.

source.notes: Orsino offers player-side combatants Flee every turn: an even chance (Math.random() < 0.5; Kyr rolls from the seeded stream) to end the fight. Kyr's company gives ground with each try that fails: three in four the second time, sure the third; and in the first round of a fight that fell on it unwarned, which it saw begin, it acts first and gets away for certain. Orsino's monster Escape skill rolls a will save that, as written for fear effects, makes a successful save fail; Kyr uses the player rule's even chance for every creature on the other side that flees.

fire_ward.name: Fire ward
fire_ward.description: Ward a companion against fire for about two hours.

source.notes: Kyr technique granted by a ward focus; applies fireproof on the world clock for twelve units.

howl.name: Howl
howl.description: A long howl that turns the blood cold: whoever hears it fights afraid for a while.
howl.effect: Apply fear to enemies for 2 turns unless wisdom save against (12).

source.notes: A wolf's howl, whatever wolf (the owner, 6 November: not a winter howl). The bites, rime and rending, and the bronze custodian's sweep and chain are gone: a beast bites with its natural weapon, and a custodian sweeps as a fighter does and strikes with its chain.

breathe_fire.name: Fire breath
breathe_fire.description: Fire pours over everyone before the creature. A quick or hardy creature takes half. The fire takes a while to rekindle; three times a day at most.

source.notes: Area fire damage scales as 2d6 + 2 per creature level, with a breath save for half and a three-turn recharge. Maturity supplies a generated dragon level; its natural bite remains available. A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

breathe_cold.name: Cold breath
breathe_cold.description: Breath pours over everyone before the creature; a breath save halves damage. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

conjure_light.name: Light
conjure_light.description: A small steady light that hangs over a companion's shoulder for two hours.
conjure_light.effect: Apply lit to ally for 2 hours.

source.notes: The old-school Light spell, which Orsino's catalog lacks; every mage learns it as an apprentice.

knock.name: Knock
knock.description: For an hour, locks and bars open at the caster's touch.
knock.effect: Apply unbarring to ally for 1 hour.

source.notes: The old-school Knock, which Orsino's catalog lacks: whoever bears it may do what lockwork does for an hour.

pratfall.name: Pratfall
pratfall.description: Go down on purpose as the blow comes, the way a clown goes down a flight of stairs: it lands on nothing, and you are up again behind it.
pratfall.effect: Apply dodge to self for 2 turns.

source.notes: The first foundation of the Gentle Art (Wapshott's Circus): a fall chosen, not suffered. Orsino's dodge status, for one exchange, on a longer recharge than Dodge itself.

feint.name: Feint
feint.description: Show the eye one thing and the hand another: the shoulder that says left while the hip goes right. A foe who follows it strikes at where you are not.
feint.effect: Apply distracted to enemy for 2 turns unless wisdom save against (12).

source.notes: The third foundation of the Gentle Art (Wapshott's Circus): the fencing-master's feint taught with a broom handle. Orsino's distracted status, as a technique rather than the arcane Minor Distraction.

echo.name: Echo
echo.description: Give a foe back its own voice and bearing, a beat late, until it cannot tell which of you it is answering: the second degree of the Gentle Art.
echo.effect: Apply distracted to enemies for 1 turn unless wisdom save against (13).

source.notes: Mother Pell's art of voices (Wapshott's Circus, Phase II): imitation as attention, not mimicry of powers. Orsino's distracted status on every foe for one exchange; nothing of a foe's abilities is copied.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.description: Give a foe's own weight back to it, as the mirror-door of Pell and Fell gives back a movement: its rush carries it over its own feet.
reversal.effect: Deal (1d8) physical damage to enemy unless dexterity save against (13).

source.notes: Taught by Mumchance and Mother Pell together (Wapshott's Circus, Phase II): the door to the Mirror, and not the Mirror. Damage by the foe's own momentum, which a quick foe avoids.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Stand in front of a companion: until your next turn, blows aimed at them strike you.
guard.effect: Apply guarded to ally for 2 turns.

source.notes: A warrior's interception, in place of positions or reach.

maul.name: Maul
maul.description: Make a powerful attack that deals 1d6 + strength modifier extra damage and inflicts bleeding on a successful hit.
maul.windup: rears up on its hind legs

source.notes: Orsino's Maul without its slow (which Kyr cannot execute), given to bears as a blow they gather for a turn first: stun the bear in between and it is lost.

detonation.name: Detonation
detonation.description: A fiery explosion: fire over everyone it is set against, and nothing left of it.

source.notes: Orsino's 2d6 fire on the enemies, then the charge gone; its damage to the enemies is the shape Arrow Volley plays, which the generated record had not.

breathe_disintegration.name: Disintegrating breath
breathe_disintegration.description: A breath that unmakes what it touches pours over everyone before the creature; a breath save halves it. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A dragon lineage's breath weapon, of the shape every breath has: all its foes, a save vs breath for half, three turns to breathe again. A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

breathe_thunder.name: Deafening breath

energy_drain.name: Energy drain
energy_drain.description: A cold touch that takes a level of the one it lands on: their strength in a fight, their spells and their health, until a restoration gives it back.

source.notes: Kyr's own, the old games' energy drain (the wight's and the wraith's touch: a level for each that lands, no save); Orsino's undead drain no levels. Rests three turns, as Orsino's skills that name none.

greater_energy_drain.name: Greater energy drain
greater_energy_drain.description: A touch that takes two levels of the one it lands on, until a restoration gives them back.

source.notes: Kyr's own, the old games' vampire's and spectre's drain of two levels a touch; Orsino's undead drain no levels.

restoration.name: Restoration
restoration.description: A prayer that gives back to one who was drained what the dead took: every level lost.

source.notes: Kyr's own, the old games' restoration, the one remedy for energy drain (a temple's service, or a cleric's spell). It lifts every level taken at once, where the old games give back one a casting.
